European specialty grocery, the way it tastes at home

Euro Village is a modern European specialty grocery store — and our newest location is coming to Kendall Marketplace in Yorkville, Illinois.

About our concept

Euro Village is a modern European specialty grocery store focused on authentic imported products from across Europe — with a particular love for the foods of Eastern and Central Europe.

Our shelves carry the brands and flavors our customers grew up with — products that simply aren't available in conventional U.S. grocery stores — presented in a clean, bright, well-organized small-format market.

It's a proven concept: our first store is established and operating, and we're now bringing the same market to Illinois.

  • Authentic imports, sourced directly from European producers
  • Small-format specialty store — quality and personal service first
  • An established, operating first location behind the concept

Departments

Eight departments of imported European foods — from the deli counter to the freezer case — including beloved brands you won't find in a conventional supermarket.

Specialty Meats

Cured and smoked meats, salamis, hams, and sausages made the European way — sliced fresh at the counter.

Cheeses & Dairy

Aged and fresh cheeses, butter, kefir, yogurts, and cultured dairy from European creameries.

Bakery

Hearty rye and sourdough loaves, rolls, pastries, and sweet bakes in the European tradition.

Sweets & Chocolates

Chocolates, pralines, wafers, candies, and cookies from Europe's best-known confectioners.

Beverages

Mineral waters, juices, compotes, and soft drinks imported from across Europe.

Frozen Foods

Dumplings, pierogi, frozen vegetables, berries, and ready dishes — everyday staples of the European kitchen.

Preserves

Pickles, marinated vegetables, jams, spreads, and pantry preserves made from family recipes.

Spices & Pantry

Seasonings, grains, oils, sauces, and imported pantry brands that anchor European home cooking.

Why Euro Village

A specialty market built to add something new to its shopping center — not to duplicate what's already there.

01

A specialty niche, not a supermarket

We stock imported European specialty foods — a category conventional grocery anchors don't carry. Euro Village complements the center's existing stores rather than competing with them.

02

A destination that draws shoppers

Customers travel across the region for authentic European products they can't get anywhere else — bringing destination traffic and repeat visits to the whole center.

03

Built for the community it serves

The Chicago area is home to one of the largest European communities in the U.S. — and a growing audience of food lovers discovering these cuisines for the first time.

04

Clean, modern, service-first

A bright, well-organized small-format store with knowledgeable staff, careful merchandising, and a strong focus on quality and customer service.

Locations

One established store, and a second on its way to Illinois.
